items.scene: A zebra's X-ray on the light box shows a small FRACTURE ("frahk-TEWR") in its striped leg, now in a cast.
A footballer's ankle twisted IN TORSION ("ahn-TORS"): a SPRAIN, wrapped in a big blue ice pack.
The BOSS ("BOS") in a suit has bumped his head, and a big cartoon BUMP pops up under his hand; a camel behind shows off its HUMP.
A calm EVACUATION ("ay-vah-kwah-SYOHN") drill: a mother duck leads her ducklings out under the green exit lamp.
A patient slides into the big doughnut SCANNER ("skah-NEHR") as the screen fills with friendly bones.
A lifeguard who SAVED ("soh-vuh") a little swimmer wheels him in, still hugging the red float: a RESCUE.
ANDY'S CAP ("ahn-dee-KAHP") flies off as he races his sports wheelchair up the ramp, grinning; DISABILITY never stops him.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: La radiologie in the B19_hopital building, second floor (east, radiology). Camera: from the ward door, facing east into the radiology suite.
Setting: dove-grey walls with a long glowing X-ray light-box wall; floor: smooth sea-green rubber floor. Landmark: a big doughnut-shaped SCANNER machine with a sliding bed in the centre. Light: soft cool daylight plus the glow of the light boxes. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the double door behind, in the near left foreground, showing the powder-blue ward (way to La salle des lits).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, middle distance: A zebra's X-ray on the light box shows a small FRACTURE in its striped leg, now in a cast.
- left, foreground: A footballer's ankle twisted IN TORSION: a SPRAIN, wrapped in a big blue ice pack.
- centre-left, middle distance: The BOSS in a suit has bumped his head, and a big cartoon BUMP pops up under his hand; a camel behind shows off its HUMP.
- centre-right, foreground: A calm EVACUATION drill: a mother duck leads her ducklings out under the green exit lamp.
- centre-right, middle distance: A patient slides into the big doughnut SCANNER as the screen fills with friendly bones.
- far right, foreground: A lifeguard who SAVED a swimmer brings him in still hugging the red float: a RESCUE.
- far right, middle distance: ANDY'S CAP flies off as he races his sports wheelchair up the ramp, grinning; DISABILITY never stops him.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
